Subject: Our proposal against RFQ-2026-118 (corrugated packaging, FY 2027-28)
Dear Ms. Iyer,
Thank you for inviting Greenpack to participate. We have studied the thirty items and are glad to submit our proposal for twenty-seven of them. We regret that we do not manufacture 2-ply corrugated rolls in either width, and the heavy-duty 800 x 600 x 500 master carton is beyond the deckle of our corrugator, so we are not quoting for those three items.
Commercial offer
For the 3-ply regular slotted boxes, our per-box prices delivered to Bhiwandi are as follows: 150x100x80 at Rs. 1.37, 200x150x100 at Rs. 2.60, 250x200x100 at Rs. 4.08, 250x200x150 at Rs. 4.62, 300x200x150 at Rs. 5.14, 300x250x200 at Rs. 7.14, 350x250x150 at Rs. 6.93, 400x300x200 at Rs. 10.31, 450x300x250 at Rs. 13.33 and 500x350x250 at Rs. 16.75. The 2-colour tear-strip returns box (320x240x120) will be Rs. 7.15 per box.
For the 5-ply boxes the prices per box are 300x250x200 at Rs. 15.13, 350x300x250 at Rs. 21.83, 400x300x300 at Rs. 26.24, 450x350x300 at Rs. 31.62, 500x400x300 at Rs. 38.41, 600x400x400 at Rs. 49.37 and 600x450x450 at Rs. 56.31. For the largest 5-ply size, 750x500x450, we propose 140 GSM outer liners in place of the specified 150 GSM, which in our experience meets the same 22 BF requirement, and on that basis our price is Rs. 70.50 per box.
Die-cut mailers are our speciality. Per thousand mailers, with 2-colour printing, we offer Rs. 3,710 for 200x150x50, Rs. 5,730 for 250x200x60, Rs. 8,150 for 300x220x80 and Rs. 11,450 for 350x250x100. A one-time die and block charge of Rs. 18,000 per size is payable with the first order.
Partitions will be supplied at Rs. 3.91 per set for the 6-cell and Rs. 9.97 per set for the 12-cell. Layer pads are Rs. 1.57 each for the 3-ply 400x300 and Rs. 6.77 each for the 5-ply 600x400.
All prices are in Indian Rupees, exclusive of GST, and include delivery to your Bhiwandi fulfilment centre in full truck loads; part loads below 4 MT will attract freight at actuals. Prices are firm until 31 March 2027 and thereafter linked to the kraft paper index quarterly. We request payment within 30 days of invoice.
About our quality systems
Greenpack has been ISO 9001 certified since 2017 and a copy of our certificate is attached. We run a fully equipped in-house laboratory covering bursting strength, edge crush and Cobb. Our monthly converting capacity is around 420 tonnes. In the last financial year our customer rejection rate was 2.8%, mainly on account of a print registration issue on one account which has since been resolved. We are FSC certified and use about 90% recycled kraft. Our normal lead time to Bhiwandi is 12 days from receipt of the purchase order.
We look forward to a long association.

Yours sincerely,
Rohit Kulkarni
